messages:
marta: quick idea — can we add a per-config TTL to temporary overrides so shadow routing / sampling overrides expire automatically?
ben: +1. we keep hitting stale shadow overrides that skew metrics for days.
carla: how would this interact with dry-run/shadow mode? we still want long-lived dry-runs for some customers.
marta: propose two fields: `override_ttl_secs` and `persist_on_success` (bool). default ttl = 0 (never expire). dry-run configs get nonzero ttl by default when created from console quick-shadow.
ben: sounds ok. need to ensure console UX shows expiry and a countdown. otherwise PMs complain.
kevin_pdt: product: we want defaults that are conservative. maybe `override_ttl_secs` default = 86400 (24h) for console quick-shadow, and infinite for API-created overrides unless caller sets ttl.
ryan_oncall: from ops POV we need a hard global max_ttl cap (e.g. 30d) plus an auditor alert when overrides > 7d.
carla: telemetry: we'll want an event when override created and when it expires + a tag with `ttl_source` (console|api|admin). also sample evals at higher rate while shadow is active.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new config-override TTL feature landed to staging at `rev:cfg-ttl-PR#412` :rocket:
ben: implementation notes — backend will store `expires_at` computed server-side; clients supply ttl secs. will need index on `expires_at` for eviction job.
marta: eviction job should be soft (mark state=expired) then background cleanup. avoids race with active requests.
carla: metrics snippets we can use to track impact:
```
# count active shadows
sum by (config_name) (count_over_time(config.override_active[1m]))
# audit: long-lived overrides
config.override_created{ttl_seconds>604800}
```
kevin_pdt: UX question — when override expires do we send a console notification + email to owner? prefer single opt-in per workspace.
ben: agree. add `owner_contact` and `workspace_notification: true|false`.
ryan_oncall: alerting: add an alert when expired_override_count increases unexpectedly > 3x baseline in 5m window. bad rollouts show up that way.
marta: timeline: I'll draft a small RFC. devs can pick up API + DB fields. carla please add telemetry events and dashboard tiles. ben add eviction job + console badge.
carla: ack, will add new panels: active shadows, avg ttl, expired per workspace.
kevin_pdt: ok — product will update rollout playbook and default policies.
ben: quick Q — do we allow nested overrides (override-of-override)? if yes, TTLs should be independent. prefer simple: disallow override stacking; console shows explicit replace.
marta: agreed, disallow stacking for now. we'll revisit.
ops-bot: note: scheduled migration to add `expires_at` column tomorrow 02:00 UTC — will lock writes for 30s.
ryan_oncall: I'll coordinate oncall for the migration window.
kevin_pdt: thanks all. next step: RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
